title: Microburst Cost Simulator & Pricing Policy Editor (token-level)
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Problem: Teams need a lightweight way to understand short-lived (microburst) traffic events at token granularity and to see how pricing rules, discounts, and cache behavior change the final bill. The current console shows aggregate per-day spend and coarse attributions; it is hard to simulate pricing policy changes (reserved capacity discounts, per-route price overrides, quantization savings) and to export a compact per-request ledger for audits.

Goal: Design a compact interactive "Microburst Cost Simulator" panel that lives alongside the per-route cost dashboard. The panel should: (1) ingest a selectable time window or sample of request traces, (2) visualize token consumption spikes as a condensed sparkline + distribution bands, (3) provide a live pricing policy editor (overrides, tiers, reserved discounts, cache-hit crediting) and apply those until previewed on the traces, and (4) allow export of a filtered per-token ledger (CSV/NDJSON) with provenance columns (route, model-variant, cache-hit, quant profile, discount applied).

Non-goals: This ticket is for the console UX and prototype; backend accounting pipelines and ingestion of full historical traces are tracked in ENG work. We will use sampled traces (1% or up to 10k events) for the prototype to keep UI responsiveness high.
acceptance_criteria: A compact Microburst panel mock exists in Figma that can be embedded into the Route Cost view and the main Cost Overview pane.
Interactive pricing policy editor prototype: add/edit rules that affect per-token unit price, with immediate recalculation visible on the selected trace sample.
Per-token ledger export: CSV schema defined, export button on prototype that triggers a downloadable sample (server stub OK for prototype).
Clear UX for cache attribution: UI shows percentage of tokens covered by KV/prefix cache and credits applied to cost preview.
Design handoff notes include accessibility considerations for high-density sparkline and keyboard navigation for policy rules.
PM and two engineers have reviewed the prototype and signed off on feasibility trade-offs.
tasks: Draft initial low-fi flows (3 variations) showing how the Microburst panel expands from a mini sparkline into detail.
Iterate hi-fi prototype with pricing editor controls (sliders, toggles, named policy presets).
Define export CSV/NDJSON columns and example rows for the engineering contract.
Run a design review with PM, runtime eng, and billing eng; capture feasibility notes and required API surface.
Prepare design tokens and component variants for later implementation (compact table, policy editor rows, chip states).
engineering_notes: Prototype will use sampled traces provided by ENG: trace_sample_api v1 (max 10k events) to avoid large payloads in-browser.
Engineering flagged potential perf cost for client-side recomputation of cost when adjusting policies; suggested server-side delta calculations for >2k events.
Batching and KV cache attribution must align with runtime event fields: (cache_hit:boolean, kv_prefix_id:string, model_variant:string, token_count:int).
Export format: CSV for spreadsheets and NDJSON for ingestion. Include a compact token_provenance field to avoid nested schema on export.
